name: serving
description: LLM serving: the fields that define an engine step's load and a run's regime. A step is an engine step (phase "engine"); startup work runs in named steps (phase load_model, profile_run, capture_model, capture_model_profile) that carry no required fields.

phase.note: engine for engine steps; the startup method's name for named steps

rows.source: scheduler: tokens in the forward pass, speculative rows included

context_lengths.source: scheduler: per request, computed tokens plus tokens scheduled this step

kind.source: adapter: a request is prefilling when it schedules more tokens than 1 + its draft tokens; empty when nothing is scheduled (the runner still updates its state)

fingerprint.source: adapter: hash of the scheduled request ids and token counts, identical on every rank

phase_clock.note: the benchmark client's phase boundaries, realtime seconds, aligned through clock pairs by the census

applies_to: processes with engine steps (the model-runner workers)
